title: The right to disconnect: France (2017) and Australia (2024)

sources.title: France Just Gave Workers the ‘Right to Disconnect’ From Work Email
French Law Giving Workers ‘The Right To Disconnect’ Goes Into Effect
Australia is the latest country to give workers the ‘right to disconnect’ after hours

facts.text: From 1 January 2017, a French law has required companies with more than 50 employees to negotiate limits on work email outside working hours.
Australia’s right to disconnect took effect on 26 August 2024 for employers with 15 or more employees and in 2025 for smaller businesses.
Under the Australian rule, employees may refuse to monitor, read or respond to work contact outside working hours unless the refusal is unreasonable.
Whether a refusal is unreasonable depends on factors such as the reason for the contact, the employee’s role and whether the employee is paid to stay available.

notes: 混合題 mixed-top-04 第 5 組（下班後不回訊息的權利，8 則讀者留言）用。2026-10-09 線上查證，只取事實、不取原句。引言只寫法國 2017、澳洲 2024 兩點（f1、f2）；「本地正在討論類似法案」與八則留言是虛構的情境與意見，留言裡的條件（緊急狀況、待命加給、跨時區合作）呼應 f3、f4 的「是否合理」判斷因素。
